evidence.experimental_conditions: MCI/MI at 0.01% or 0.02% aq, patch test on 10 patients
evidence.support_text: Baseline series patch tests were performed on 10 patients with suspected photoaggravated contact dermatitis to MCI/MI or MI. Test concentrations were MCI/MI 0.01% or 0.02% aq. Seven patients had positive patch tests to both MCI/MI and MI, and 3 patients had positive patch tests to only MI. Thus, 7 out of 10 patients had a positive patch test to MCI/MI.

evidence.experimental_conditions: MI at 0.2% aq, patch test on 10 patients
evidence.support_text: Baseline series patch tests were performed on 10 patients with suspected photoaggravated contact dermatitis to MCI/MI or MI. Test concentration for MI was 0.2% aq. Seven patients had positive patch tests to both MCI/MI and MI, and 3 patients had positive patch tests to only MI, thereby all 10 patients had positive patch tests to MI.
Among the 335 patients testing positively for MCI/MI and/or MI during 2010-2012, all were positive for skin sensitization as determined by patch testing.
